sayLines.line: Sean is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Neem. Feathery leaves, bitter smell. Medicine, not food — small amounts only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s taught the man in his 30s Herbal Medicine.
📓 Codex: Nolan taught Hoai Herbal Medicine.
📓 Codex: Amina taught Mara Herbal Medicine.

Hannah came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
★ Deeper knowledge: Blackberry. Parts: berries (eat), leaves (tea), roots (medicinal). Pick ripe (black, not red). (Yield +50%). Use unlocked: food: ripe black berries, straight off the cane.

Deeper knowledge: Blackberry. Uses: vitamin C, antioxidants. Leaves for diarrhea. High energy. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: ripe black berries, straight off the cane; medicine: leaf tea settles the stomach; dye: deep purple-black dye from the juice.
